connection.status: Compact Povo 2 bridge arrival with enclosed stairs down
connection.assumptions: User-authorized compact adaptation: retain the two bridge-exit alcoves, replace W1 with gray enclosed stairs down to a small closed lower landing, remove E1 and everything from W2/E2 onward. Bridge connects floor 1 in both buildings. Original survey/photo floor references are preserved separately.

povo2.status: Integrated lower floors using the completed compact staircase
povo2.entrance_orientation: Enter from west looking east: right is south; left is north.
povo2.basement_arrangement: Exit the integrated stair east, turn right/south down the long corridor, then turn right/west at its far end. The standalone drawing is rotated 180 degrees during integration.
assumptions: The west-facing entrance and metric subdivisions are a gameplay layout inferred from the narrated route, not a surveyed plan.
3.6 m storeys align the existing bridge at 7.6 m with ground at 4.0 m; basement levels 0.4 and -3.2 m are provisional.

Turn right from the entrance to face south: tables occupy the right half of the hall, with B111-B114 numbered from the entrance on the opposite side. Boards are on the north wall, opposite their previous position.
The reception front wall continues north/left, with only a stair-access opening.
The B111-B114 corridor wall is flush with the reception front at east coordinate 21 m. The hall ends flush with the final classroom.
Reception has continuous transparent glazing with no player opening, gray office furniture and three posed staff including a woman at the front desk.
Parking is a generic covered layout with rubberized grey asphalt and five simple car meshes.
Approved exterior connects through the double entrance and overlaps the covered parking; integration is generated by config/povo_exterior.json.
